hook: She passed out on a container ship off the Washington coast.
narration: A woman passed out aboard a container ship off the Washington coast.
She was having trouble breathing, and the ship was out near Neah Bay.
A Coast Guard Dolphin helicopter from Air Station Port Angeles came out over the ship.
The only open space aboard was a small helicopter pad, with white water churning along the hull.
The crew sent down a rescue litter, a rigid stretcher that keeps a patient flat and strapped in for the ride up.
[short pause] Then it lifted off the deck. Feet off the deck. Try to come back to each swing on her.
The flight mechanic caught the swinging litter and guided it in through the door.
outcome: The Port Angeles crew brought her to a local hospital for higher medical care.
title: Passed out on a ship off Washington
description:
On Jan. 30, 2021, a Coast Guard MH-65 Dolphin crew from Air Station Port Angeles hoisted a woman off a container ship near Neah Bay, Washington, after she had trouble breathing and lost consciousness, and flew her to a hospital.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video, Air Station Port Angeles, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/782117/coast-guard-medevacs-woman-container-ship-off-wa-coast
